primary_source.summary: Primer inserts per-channel depthwise temporal convolution after Q/K/V projections. This motivates testing an isolated local information path; its combined architecture and larger English results do not establish Japanese10M benefit.

architecture.formula: For each original projected Q/K/V channel: mixed_p[t]=p[t]+a1*p[previous_valid_token]+a2*p[second_previous_valid_token]
architecture.coefficient_granularity: each original projected channel in each layer, independent Q/K/V
architecture.norm_and_position_order: project, causal lag mixing, original Q/K norm, original RoPE, original GQA SDPA and O
architecture.padding: lags count valid tokens, not physical padding; missing history zero; never cross document/sequence rows
architecture.cache: separate tagged KV cache: original post-RoPE K/mixed V plus last two valid RAW pre-mixing Q/K/V per layer and validity
architecture.native_directory_or_HF_export: explicit refusal until separate inference/export adapter exists

difference_from_paper: Own residual adaptation: current tap fixed1, two previous taps learned from0, original GQA/NoQKNorm/RoPE/SwiGLU retained. Not full Primer, not exact MDHA implementation, no squared-ReLU combination or speedup claim.
